title: Normalized finite affine-line trace with internal Noetherian witness
statement: The finite coefficient datum P of [def-pur-conventions] and the affine-line compactification of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison] give the actual normalized trace over a finite-type scheme B with structure aB. Define trace(P,B,aB) to be AffineLinePurity.integration at the recorded exponent, inserting isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType(aB) and the invertibility primeUnit(P,B,aB). It is exactly the projective trace restricted to the affine open and transported by the standard coefficient normalization. No trace or counit equality is asserted.
